description: Renovate owns the GitHub Actions pins. Chart files (appVersion, image tags, subchart deps, silo digest) are owned by the Hermes weekly sweep, which bumps Chart.yaml `version:` atomically with the change — ct enforces check-version-increment on every changed chart, which Renovate cannot satisfy across files, so chart-file PRs would be permanently red.

packageRules.description: Subchart dep bumps change charts/** without a chart version bump -> ct fails; owned by Hermes weekly sweep
App-version bumps need an atomic chart version bump; owned by Hermes weekly sweep
Image tags live in chart values files; owned by Hermes weekly sweep
All chart-content updates owned by Hermes weekly sweep (ct check-version-increment)
